title: PHS 398 Research Training Program Plan
description: Source-reviewed Research Training Program Plan definition and UUID preview. Application context, file contents and XML integration remain separately tracked.
notes: Original FID798 XLS was freshly read with SheetJS. Original PDF page1 was rendered and completely inspected, confirming14 document slots, five groups, OMB0925-0001 and expiration12/31/2027. Exact typed cells, source hashes and context truth tables are in the pinned source review packet.

The root is the training-program document aggregate with13 named singleton UUID references and an optional ordered Appendix UUID array. Five UI headings reference those fields without creating capture wrappers. Seven shared purposes use Questions.Research.Documents; training ProgramPlan and ProgressReport remain distinct from ResearchStrategy and ProgressReportPublicationList, and participating-faculty biosketches are not person-profile or overflow biographies.

DAT K8 supplies Introduction Add/Delete/View when separate R&R SF424 ApplicationTypeCode is Revision or Resubmission; Q8 requires its PDF for those values. K8 does not state otherwise-disabled-and-cleared. K14 enables ProgressReport only for Renewal/Resubmission, requires it for Renewal, makes it optional for Resubmission, and explicitly disables and clears it otherwise. Q20 requires VertebrateAnimals when the separate R&R Other Project Information animals-used answer is Yes. These exact external obligations require a bound context integration; no executable applicability pass is claimed.

DAT K25/Q25 limits Appendix to10 PDFs, while root XSD Appendix uses AttachmentGroupMin0Max100DataType and allows0..100 files. The applicant definition preserves the narrower DAT business rule; the source-shaped XSD retains100. Parity records the group-versus-file occurrence and source-layer difference without granting a waiver.

Every named field retains its full Q help tip. Training Program Section retains R10 and R14 mandatory messages plus the K14 availability/clearing instruction. All singleton K cells request Add/Delete/View, and K25 requests Multi-Attachment features. UUID preview controls do not provide an actual upload lifecycle.

Burden notice (DAT K5/Q5): Public reporting burden for this collection of information is estimated to average 10 hours per response, including the time for reviewing instructions, searching existing data sources, gathering and maintaining the data needed, and completing and reviewing the collection of information.  An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a currently valid OMB control number.  Send comments regarding this burden estimate or any other aspect of this collection of information, including suggestions for reducing this burden, to: NIH, Project Clearance Branch, 6705 Rockledge Drive, MSC 7974, Bethesda, MD 20892-7974, ATTN: PRA (0925-0001).  Do not return the completed form to this address.

Source-shaped XSD models preserve required ResearchTrainingProgramPlanAttachments, named attFile wrappers, Appendix0..100, targetNamespaceV5.0 and fixed FormVersion5.0. No active XML Mapping.from is declared.

Examples use illustrative UUIDs with no uploaded document behind them. Upload metadata resolution, API registration, XML generator/emitter strategy, signing and submission remain separate integration work. agencyCode SGG follows conventional library registration and is not a source HHS agency-code assertion.
risks: Unknown external application-type/animal-use context must remain unable to verify. Do not default it to New or No or transfer ProgressReport clearing to Introduction.
PDF content and FOA/agency page limits need actual file and opportunity evidence. UUID validation proves neither file existence, ownership, metadata nor submission readiness.

The source Appendix permits absent and present-empty group states and ordered duplicate occurrences. Later XML handling needs an explicit absence/empty policy; this definition adds no uniqueness constraint.
